decisions.because: Requirement (ROADMAP, percolation row and item 10): a peer whose detector misfires, or a compromised peer within its envelope, spreads its blocks to every node that takes them; until now only the aggregate sokol_blocks_active showed it, once the map filled.

statement: Every claim a peer sends, by Claim or BlockSync, is counted under its issuer and what this node did with it (enforced, held, refused, known) in sokol_mesh_claims_total; the first MAX_ISSUERS issuers get their own label, later ones count as other. SokolPeerClaimSurge fires when one issuer's enforced and held claims surge.
